top_buyer_moments.title: SaaS marketer translating customer situations into AI-ad context — Buyer Moment Discovery
top_buyer_moments.problem: The team has product and customer evidence but lacks a disciplined way to rank which commercial contexts deserve an experiment.
top_buyer_moments.situation: A B2B SaaS marketer is deciding which customer situations are specific enough to test in an AI advertising channel.
top_buyer_moments.desired_outcome: Prioritize a small set of evidence-backed contexts and turn them into reviewable experiment hypotheses.

matching_products.name: Buyer Moment Discovery
matching_products.description: Evidence-backed discovery and ranking of customer situations that may deserve an advertising experiment.

evidence.text: BuyerMoment generates and ranks evidence-backed Buyer Moments with supporting evidence and confidence.

supporting_evidence.text: BuyerMoment is positioned as commercial-context intelligence for AI advertising, not a generic copywriter, ad network, or autonomous media buyer.
The repository implements a deterministic ContextFit scorer with budget, feature, location, stage, and ad-relevance reasoning codes.
SpendDecision supports TEST, WATCH, ABSTAIN, and BLOCK, with human approval required.
Candidate commercial situation: SaaS marketer translating customer situations into AI-ad context

top_buyer_moments.title: Advertiser linking context hypotheses to outcomes — Buyer Moment Discovery
top_buyer_moments.problem: A campaign result is hard to interpret if the original Buyer Moment, score, offer, and experiment version are not preserved.
top_buyer_moments.situation: An advertiser wants to learn whether commercial-context quality predicts useful experiment outcomes.
top_buyer_moments.desired_outcome: Keep an immutable lineage from Buyer Moment to experiment to manually imported outcome.
